nodes.assumption: The 'reseal door' is an automated mechanism triggered when the commit is made (via git commit or post-commit hook) that reproves affected proofs. The command 'cairn test --hollow 9245b9cbce53 --seal' is the standard way to run a hollow build test on the ticket and seal its validation, and it is run after the reseal completes.
nodes.would_settle: Clarify whether the reseal door runs automatically on commit or requires manual invocation; document what the --hollow flag does and when it runs; explicitly sequence the commands: local proof runs, commit, reseal, hollow test.
